Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SUPERChem · documents: SUPERChem's checklist calls for question-source clarity, duplicate checking, plausible distractors, explanations that remain semantically complete and logically coherent after all checkpoints are removed, Chinese/English meaning consistency and correct rendering; its leakage mitigations include masking nonessential entities and discouraging reverse solving.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.superchem.quality-and-leakage-limits.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The current dataset card explicitly acknowledges that errors and typos may remain.
  • The author did not treat the listed checks or design mitigations as independent proof of error-free data or absence of training contamination.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SUPERChem · documents: The current pinned evaluation repository describes DAG-based scoring in which matched reference-node weights are adjusted by matched-parent reachability, and explicitly distinguishes its historical demo from pending final manuscript input and result reconciliation.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.superchem.release-protocol-version

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The v1 paper instead describes weighted checkpoint-recall RPF; these captured descriptions are kept as separate versioned scopes.
  • The author did not execute code, reproduce demo values or promote candidate manifests and historical results to a final leaderboard.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SUPERChem · documents: The manuscript describes 633 filtered SUPERChem-All questions, partitioned into a 500-question public release and a 133-question holdout, with a separate 100-question evaluation subset.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.superchem.release-units

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Questions solved by every model in either the designated top-tier group or the baseline group were removed during filtering.
  • Appendix G samples from the 500-question Release set to study ranking stability; the author did not independently validate subset representativeness or count downloadable payloads.
  • The named sets are retained as partition/subset relationships, pending identity adjudication rather than counted as independent benchmark families.
